children: Ford Motor expects the financial hit from a recent production issue will be contained within the full-year forecast it provided in July. The automaker earlier this week disclosed a temporary production halt at a plant that makes its F-150 due to a supplier issue, a development that it said dragged on its third-quarter wholesale performance. (kelly.cloonan@wsj.com)
